capacity_01.user_message: We are comparing two staffing options, labelled exactly "Keep current staffing" and "Add one specialist". Use the exact goal label "Weekly support capacity". Our existing team resolves 80 tickets per week. Keep current staffing adds no specialist. Add one specialist adds one specialist. Each additional specialist resolves about 20 tickets per week, between 10 and 30. Total weekly support capacity is defined as the existing 80 tickets per week plus the additional specialist capacity. Goal: weekly support capacity of at least 100 tickets per week. This target is an absolute level, with no deadline.
capacity_01.assistant_text:
I’ve built the comparison around your stated capacity target.

- Today’s team capacity is **80 tickets per week** (your figure).
- The added specialist uses **20 tickets per week** as a provisional planning estimate; your range is 10–30.
- “Keep current staffing” holds today’s values; no deadline or staffing timing is modelled.

A provisional first pass has run, but it is only a draft to challenge: it has not been validated. The model can run when you ask.

This chance uses the model's numbers as they are today; the model doesn't project how they change over time yet.

Olumi's estimates: 3, see Check estimates.

Not shown yet; why is under More detail

Questions this model does not answer yet: What do you expect ‘Additional specialists’ to be? ‘Additional specialists’ is 0 today, so Olumi adds up their effects on ‘Weekly support capacity’ instead of multiplying them: treat the comparison as a rough approximation until you say. The specialist estimate ranges from 10 to 30 tickets per week; 20 tickets per week is used as the provisional planning estimate. Confirm the expected capacity after onboarding and whether the low-end 10-ticket case must still meet the target. 1 more question remains unresolved.

‘Add one specialist’: about 36% chance of meeting your goal, in this model, using Olumi's estimates for 3 relationships (see Check estimates). It rests most on Olumi’s own estimate of how strongly ‘Additional specialist capacity’ affects ‘Weekly support capacity’: if that effect is weaker than Olumi assumed, the chance falls. Is that estimate right?

Provisional: this result uses inputs whose sources have not been verified.
